_comment: FLUIX OUT OF PHOSPHOR SCRAP, in the compacted depths (owner, 2026-08-20, #276).
Fluix's defining property is that it holds charge and glows, and phosphor is the luminous
fraction of the waste. The two verbs divide cleanly and neither crowds the other: GRIND it for
glowstone dust, SEPARATE it for fluix.
This exists because AE2's own route to fluix is an in-world ritual - charged certus plus
redstone plus nether quartz thrown into water - and the owner does not want that to be how you
get it here (2026-08-20). AE2's recipe still exists and still works; this is the route that
IN THE NETHER, and certus in the overworld, which is also AE2's own tier order: certus is its
early material and fluix is what comes after. It puts the Controller behind the depths, which
is right for the one structure that eats fluix crystals directly.
Two per feed for the same reason certus is: 4 to 8 stacks a playthrough.
TEMPORARY, and guarded. This is pack content living in the engine because the pack cannot ship
data on 26.1.2; it leaves with the press pool - Flatts3000/trashlands#46.
The neoforge:mod_loaded guard is load-bearing rather than tidy. Strip it and this file does not
merely fail to apply, it fails to PARSE on its own result id - measured on the Simple Magnets
overrides in #271 - and one bad recipe file leaves a single ERROR line in an otherwise green run.
